title: Minimum percentage gain
statement: For the current-era baseline, a candidate should already be up at least 10% on the session before it qualifies as a five-pillars momentum candidate.
implementation_notes: Compute from prior regular-session close using point-in-time prices.

evidence.title: How To Start Day Trading in 2026 (full training)
evidence.note: Current training defines the first pillar as already up at least 10%.

title: Relative volume floor
statement: The current-era five-pillars baseline requires relative volume of at least 5x normal volume; higher is preferred.
implementation_notes: Use point-in-time RVOL and explicitly define the denominator/window.
contradictions_or_exceptions: Older material sometimes used lower RVOL thresholds; preserve those as historical eras.

evidence.title: How To Start Day Trading in 2026 (full training)
evidence.note: Current training states a 5x relative-volume requirement.

title: First-pullback structure
statement: A high-quality first pullback follows a strong impulse, generally retraces no more than about 50%, shows lighter selling volume than buying volume, and is strongest when VWAP/9 EMA support and positive momentum remain intact.
implementation_notes: Encode each component separately so ablations can test its contribution.

evidence.title: Growing a $2k Account to $65,662.04 in 30 Days (My Day Trading Strategy)
evidence.note: Current training describes impulse/pullback volume, support and first/second pullback quality.

title: Profit giveback lockout
statement: After building meaningful session profit, giving back half of the session high-water profit triggers a session stop in the baseline.
implementation_notes: The execution engine must reject new entries after lockout.
contradictions_or_exceptions: A more conservative 20% giveback variant may be tested separately.

evidence.title: How I Made $500,000 in 7 Days of Day Trading (Full Training)
evidence.note: Explicit walk-away rule after giving back half of session profit.

title: Raw transcripts are offline research only
statement: The live/paper trading agent and historical replay must never retrieve raw retrospective transcripts; only versioned distilled strategy knowledge may enter the decision path.
implementation_notes: Retrospective recaps can disclose the future path of the exact symbol being replayed.

title: Unknown publication dates are quarantined
statement: Any transcript without a resolved publication date is excluded from chronology-sensitive training and walk-forward experiments until its date is established.
implementation_notes: Unknown is not equivalent to old.
